items.why: Met by the spec: L2 (a relocation naming NetworkIOAgent::handleRequest) and L3 (the string React Native DevTools) tell the builds apart on built libraries, release 0 against debug and debugOptimized 1 and 2 (docs/specs/T3-28.md, Facts); the refused readings and the source reads that remain are listed there. The fixture cuts in scripts/fixtures/tv/native/ were re-read at the freeze with llvm-readelf and grep from the release AAR and APK, the debug AAR and the debugOptimized AAR (sha256 93001c05...b25f1, 177471040 bytes) and agree with the Facts table.

Already true on main: scripts/tv-apk-inspector.mjs prints its summary line and T3-28 does not change it, so the new test passes before the implement step and the red gate cannot run it; it is frozen all the same. Evidence: pnpm exec vitest run scripts/tv-apk-inspector-cli.test.ts -t "T3-28 item 4:" (4 tests, green at the freeze on ea333f94: the release recording prints one line with 1 dex, 33 classes; the debug recording fails N1, N2, N3; planted cases fail N3 and N4).
T3-16's, T3-04's and T3-19's frozen tests run in the checks job; a CI run cannot be a failing test. Locally: node scripts/check-red.mjs T3-16 --expect green, and the same for T3-04 and T3-19.
